method: Fetch pulls?state=all, issues/comments and pulls/comments with gh api --paginate; fetch paginated formal reviews for every listed pull request. No endpoint errors.

Select substantive blocking/required-change findings from reviewer verdicts, including older BLOCK/REQUEST_CHANGES/CHANGES REQUESTED variants and explicit unnumbered P1 blockers; exclude approval-only descriptions and nonblocking advisory hypotheses.

Read finding mechanism and later disposition; count one occurrence per distinct PR per root, regardless of findings or review rounds. Roots can overlap, so counts cannot be summed as independent defects.
Counts are conservative coded evidence in the harvested snapshot, not unresolved defects on current main. All comments were harvested; no numbered blocking verdict was identified in PRs <=800.
Git cluster includes explicit unnumbered blockers in #1355. RPC multibyte decoding in #1441 is a separate one-PR mechanism, excluded from Git count.
Raw comment bodies stay ignored locally. This artifact retains software-pattern paraphrases and links only.

caveats: #850 source-binding finding was resolved by a current contract exclusion for script rows; preserve frozen historical seals and do not demand blanket script resealing.
Literal TRUNCATE guards appear in approval descriptions; this is not evidence of a 3+ blocking cluster.

New structural checker covers simple assert.equal/assert.strictEqual live SCAC/current selector comparisons with version strings or REGISTRY_Vn_VERSION, including direct import aliases; it is not a complete JavaScript analyzer or a check of all successor consumers.
#1344 has a blocked moving release-identity literal test; #1499 describes live registry literal fragility only in approval. Neither is added to the three successor-consumer blocking occurrences.
